name: Convert
author: Dante Regis
description: Type a conversion, get the answer. Currencies with live rates, plus length, mass, volume, temperature, speed, area, data and time.

barWidget.description: A single input box: "100 EUR in BRL", "10 km to mi", "72 F". Enter copies the result.

schema.label: Default target currency
schema.description: ISO code used when you type an amount and a currency but no target, e.g. "100 EUR".

schema.label: Secondary target currency
schema.description: Used instead when the source already is the default target currency.
